title: Fix some issues with Exported PDUs.
description:
Fix the description in wsutil/exported_pdu_tlvs.h to reflect reality
(i.e., to match what the code in Wireshark that reads the exported PDU
TLVs, and all code that writes them, does).

In the code that dissects them, treat all strings as FT_STRINGZPAD, as
any null bytes at the end of the string are padding, not part of the
string.

See merge request !3895 and issue #17535.

@@ -20,37 +20,33 @@

- * Each TLV has the form:

- *   0                   1                   2                   3

+ * TLVs are not guaranteed to be aligned to any particular number
+ * of bytes.
  *
- * The first TLV is of type EXP_PDU_TAG_OPTIONS_LENGTH; its value
- * is a 4-byte integer value, giving the length of all TLVs following

+ * The list of TLVs may begin with a TLV of type EXP_PDU_TAG_OPTIONS_LENGTH;

commits_data.message:

Fix the description in wsutil/exported_pdu_tlvs.h to reflect reality
(i.e., to match what the code in Wireshark that reads the exported PDU

In the code that dissects them, treat all strings as FT_STRINGZPAD, as
any null bytes at the end of the string are padding, not part of the

See merge request !3895 and issue #17535.
